topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I stumbled upon an image of my artwork, its lines now etched permanently into someone's skin. My throat tightened, and my hands began to tremble as I stared at the screen. It's one thing to see your work appreciated, but to find it transfigured, stripped of its original context, and claimed as part of someone's body feels... invasive. I shouldn't have to ask, but how did they get it? Did they even think to reach out? Every detail, each careful stroke, now felt violated. I stepped back from the computer, the room spinning slightly, unsure of what to do next.
